consequence.statement: The flags still work in 1.17 but will be removed in Cilium 1.18.
consequence.remediation: Use the Cilium CLI to gather a sysdump from a K8s cluster.

assertion.statement: The bugtool flag --k8s-mode (with --cilium-agent-container-name, --k8s-namespace and --k8s-label) is deprecated and will be removed in Cilium 1.18; use the Cilium CLI to gather a sysdump.

proposal.undeterminedReason: applicability: The flags belong to the bugtool command line, which is run manually. No configuration input shows whether it is used, and the text names no workload argument.
